1	# Orchard — The Best Way to Buy the Products You Love
     2	
     3	## Brand
     4	Orchard is a premium technology brand's official online store offering the latest devices, accessories, financing options, and personalized shopping experiences. The tone is minimal, modern, and professional — clean layouts with generous whitespace, product-forward imagery, and concise copy.

1 --- 2 name: ui-styling 3 description: Create beautiful, accessible user interfaces with shadcn/ui components (built on Radix UI + Tailwind), Tailwind CSS utility-first styling, and canvas-based visual designs. Use when building user interfaces, implementing design systems, creating responsive layouts, adding accessible components (dialogs, dropdowns, forms, tables), customizing themes and colors, implementing dark mode, generating visual designs and posters, or establishing consistent styling patterns across applications. 4 license: MIT 5 version: 1.0.0 6 --- 7 8 # UI Styling Skill 9 10 Comprehensive skill for creating beautiful, accessible user interfaces combining shadcn/ui components, Tailwind CSS utility styling, and canvas-based visual design systems. 11 12 ## Reference 13 14 - shadcn/ui: https://ui.shadcn.com/llms.txt 15 - Tailwind CSS: https://tailwindcss.com/docs 16 17 ## When to Use This Skill 18 19 Use when: 20 - Building UI with React-based frameworks (Next.js, Vite, Remix, Astro) 21 - Implementing accessible components (dialogs, forms, tables, navigation) 22 - Styling with utility-first CSS approach 23 - Creating responsive, mobile-first layouts 24 - Implementing dark mode and theme customization 25 - Building design systems with consistent tokens 26 - Generating visual designs, posters, or brand materials 27 - Rapid prototyping with immediate visual feedback 28 - Adding complex UI patterns (data tables, charts, command palettes) 29 30 ## Core Stack 31 32 ### Component Layer: shadcn/ui 33 - Pre-built accessible components via Radix UI primitives 34 - Copy-paste distribution model (components live in your codebase) 35 - TypeScript-first with full type safety 36 - Composable primitives for complex UIs 37 - CLI-based installation and management 38 39 ### Styling Layer: Tailwind CSS 40 - Utility-first CSS framework 41 - Build-time processing with zero runtime overhead 42 - Mobile-first responsive design 43 - steps.message:
The Orchard e-commerce website is complete. Here's a summary of what was built:

### Output Files (`/app/output/`)
- **`index.html`** — Homepage with ribbon banner, hero product grid (6 tiles), entertainment tabs (streaming/fitness/gaming/music), and footer
- **`store.html`** — Main store with product icon bar, latest products carousel (10 items), help section, store difference, accessories, audio products, brand collaboration, experience section, savings & offers, and quick links
- **`shop-laptops.html`** — Laptop category page with sticky section nav, all models carousel (6 items), shopping guides, ways to save, accessories, setup & support, and special stores
- **`shop-tablets.html`** — Tablet category page with identical structure, all tablet models carousel (4 items)
- **`assets/styles.css`** — Complete design system with CSS variables, typography, layout utilities, carousel styles, card components, responsive breakpoints, and mobile footer accordion
- **`assets/scripts.js`** — Shared JS for carousels (with prev/next buttons), entertainment tabs, sticky section navigation smooth-scroll, mobile footer accordion, and mobile nav toggle

### Key Features Implemented
| Feature | Status |
|---|---|
| Horizontal carousels with arrow navigation | ✅ All pages |
| Homepage product grid (6 hero tiles) | ✅ |
| Entertainment tabs (4 categories) | ✅ |
| Pricing accuracy from source brief | ✅ All prices match exactly |
| Sticky section nav (laptops & tablets) | ✅ Smooth-scroll to anchors |
| Footer accordion on mobile | ✅ JS-driven, responsive |
| Product icon bar on store | ✅ Links to category pages |
| All inter-page navigation | ✅ Working relative links |
| Responsive design | ✅ Mobile-first breakpoints |
| Accessibility | ✅ ARIA labels, semantic HTML |
